propositions: Data Center backend has no parametrized characterization suite pinning output VALUES (only shape assertions exist in test_backend_contract.py), asymmetric to Cloud's hardened test_backend_characterization.py which is bound to JiraBackend only

DC's separate implementations (_DCOutbound, _DCInbound, _DCSanitizer, _map_local_to_dc_fields) are never exercised by value-level pins for priority/status maps, sanitizer boundaries, identity label forms, or field mappings

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote body is never driven through WikiTextCodec, only through AdfCodec, leaving DC composition regressions (dropped length fit, lost guards, mis-mapped fields) undetectable
DC's probe classifier is unreachable through the _backend() seam because FakeTransport.probe_remote hard-codes UNREACHABLE unconditionally, so probe branches cannot be pinned that way

DC binds its own DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES (byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES at defaults, making a default-only pin vacuous) but this must be verified with a non-default custom set to prove the binding is real
